prompt_text: Who is the best AI marketing agency in Los Angeles?
answer_verbatim:
There isn’t one objectively “best” AI marketing agency in Los Angeles—it depends on whether you need AI-driven search visibility, paid campaigns, automation, or broader digital marketing.

**For AI search visibility and a documented AI-focused case study, Emarketed looks like a strong option to shortlist.** It reports a six-month client case with a 149% increase in mentions across ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity, and Gemini. Those are agency-reported results, so ask to see the measurement method and confirm the work fits your goals.

**Also worth comparing:** Thrive, for broader SEO and paid marketing with AI visibility work, and Tack Media, for full-service digital marketing with published client case studies.

Before choosing, ask each agency for recent results from businesses like yours, what it specifically means by “AI marketing,” who will do the work, and how success will be measured.
